title: Combined v3: c002 + verifier-guided RL sampling (Leon's line-level rejection sampler, ported to lean_seq)
description: c002's recipe with RL rollouts sampled under line-level guidance: each `have` the model finishes is checked against nd_verify's rules given the lines before it, and a bad segment is rolled back and resampled (4 retries). Runs in parallel with c003, both single deltas on c002; pretraining runs on the pod.
hypothesis: Most failed RL samples die at one invalid line (rule-check or unbound-name errors dominate the 186 model's failures); resampling that line instead of the whole proof turns them into verified proofs for hard targets, so each round's training mix covers more long targets. CPU check: 66/64 vs 42/41 accepted of 192 at k=8.
expected_delta: +20 to +80 over c002 (804); RL sampling slower per sample (Python checks per step), total maybe ~2,600-3,000 s

pretrain.source: 186-claude pretrain.py run on the pod (300 s), seeds 0/1/2; not the saved weights (see c003 relaunch.md)
pretrain.arch: ALiBiGPT 6x384 Peri-LN, 8 heads (4 ALiBi + 4 NoPE), d_ff 1280

config.data: fork 51604b3: train.jsonl cap-6 (retention), 1,500 rl_targets sampled with the harness seed, dev half of transfer (1,108) for eval
config.eval: frozen harness stage_eval: EVAL_K 64, T 0.8, max_new 512; metric = dev solved at L_true >= 7
config.total_secs: 3600 cap; the harness total includes the 300 s pretraining

rl.sampler: guided.generate: line-level verifier-guided RL sampling (Leon's run-2 guided sampler ported to lean_seq: fork inverse() on the prefix + Leon's LineChecker; rejected segments masked out of the KV cache and resampled; 4 retries per segment, 24 per row, segment cap 400) + compaction + Lean overlap; eval = frozen harness sampler, unguided
